events.title: Wretched Lead is now Cannon Keep!
events.summary: Hey everyone! As you might have noticed, we have changed the name from "Wretched Lead" to "Cannon Keep". As much as we've grown fond of the old name, we believe "Cannon Keep" is much more clear about what the game offers, as you literally build a keep with lots of cannons! Alongside the name change we also took the time to update the screenshots and description, since the old ones were outdated at this point.
